title: Lifecycle — Durable local work resumption without renewing execution authority
body:
## Current disposition — 2026-10-06

The bounded durable local work-resumption implementation in #1394 is included in merged #1404. The reviewed expiry/resumption correction preserves immutable original authority and does not renew execution grants. Subsequent #1407/#1410 reports establish adoption and saved-work continuity for the separately approved Mac/store. Close this implementation item. Protected retained-candidate transfer, hosted adoption and broader lifecycle/retirement remain separate; #1212/#1215/#1372 retain those obligations. Historical failed verification stays failed.

This user-authorized reconciliation is tracked in #1209. Earlier scopes and evidence below are preserved verbatim as history; their then-current Draft/open wording is superseded only by this disposition. No source/runtime, verification, provider, migration, deployment or merge operation is performed by closing this issue.

---

## Preserved earlier task and evidence record

User-authorized first lifecycle implementation slice, following the 2026-10-04 audit review and “진행하자”. The goal is to return to saved work after hours, days, or a process restart and continue through the ordinary product flow. Human operators and authorized agents should not have to manage packet lifetimes or repair a database to do that.

This issue owns bounded local source changes, disposable verification, and a Draft PR. ChatGPT/user own the outcome and invariants; local Codex owns current-source diagnosis and the implementation, file, function, and test choices. It does not prescribe a blanket expiry removal.

**Entry and source baseline**

- Repository/root: `hynk-studio/augnes` / `/Users/hynk/code/augnes`.
- Reviewed predecessor: Draft PR #1392, branch `codex/1384-source-bound-work-handoff`, head `d9b6b56f0de6dcb0a36ac591b13a3672f99fa71a`. Its bounded implementation was accepted in the continuity review; this is not merge approval or production qualification.
- The continuity lane reports its operation and cleanup complete and checkout ownership released. That report permits the next handoff; it is not a fresh local ownership check by this planning session.
- Start a separate branch `codex/lifecycle-durable-work-resumption` stacked on the confirmed #1392 branch. Re-resolve root, origin, branch, HEAD, base, worktree state, and checkout/verification ownership before work. If the predecessor moved or another lane resumed, reconcile the actual handoff and preserve unrelated work; do not reset, stash, relocate, or interrupt someone else's operation.
- Read current AGENTS and relevant 01/02/03/04 owners. Follow the repository-owned continuity/Companion contract where applicable; an unavailable or not-installed Companion is not permission to install one or to manufacture continuity evidence.

**Observed problem and implementation hypothesis**

At the inspected head, initial work and the initial-family pre-execution revision compiler already author `expires_at: null`. In contrast, stateless terminal authorship applies the eight-hour later-packet TTL, ordinary post-execution authorship inherits its predecessor's expiry, and the older scoped revalidation profile requests another finite lifetime bounded by both eight hours and the authorizing session. Ordinary successor eligibility also requires fresh packet currentness. Thus the saved-work lifecycle has different temporal behavior depending on the route used.

Relevant starting points include `initial-project-work-context.ts`, `pre-execution-project-work-revision.ts`, `stateless-terminal-authorship.ts`, `authored-successor-task.ts`, and the existing continuity/admission consumers under `lib/vnext/runtime`. These are inspection leads, not a forced edit list. Determine which ordinary paths actually dead-end and which already satisfy the requirement.

The hypothesis is that long-lived authored work can remain resumable independently of short-lived execution authority, while existing source, direction, ownership, provenance, and concurrency checks continue to govern meaningful changes. Prove the affected behavior before choosing the smallest compatible fix.

**Required behavior**

1. A saved, unexecuted work definition remains discoverable and readable after elapsed time and process restart. For affected supported native authoring families, elapsed time alone must not make editing or preparing the next ordinary task permanently unavailable. Keep the same work meaning, important constraints, attributed selected sources, and unresolved history.
2. New ordinary durable authorship must not inherit an incidental execution/pilot deadline as its user-facing lifetime. An explicit time-sensitive premise or supported finite execution/preparation profile keeps its own semantics; do not make every packet, grant, or freshness check unlimited.
3. Previously stored finite packets remain byte- and fingerprint-identical historical records. Where an expired packet needs a new current work instance, use a supported authenticated writer and current bindings to append the appropriate null-grant authored work. Do not rewrite old timestamps, replay an attempt, invent completion, or silently write on reads/previews.
4. Preserve historical compiler reconstruction. Several lineage readers rebuild the old packet and compare its exact bytes; changing only a builder's default expiry can invalidate existing history. Demonstrate compatibility for old finite and already-null packets, their successors/revisions, and affected recovery/portable readers. Choose any necessary compatibility distinction from current source rather than assuming a schema migration.
5. Reopening durable work does not renew authentication, an execution grant, a controller lease, an attempt deadline, a preparation ticket, or automation. Expired/revoked authority remains unusable. New execution still needs the existing separate, current scoped admission. Preserve cancellation, unsettled/unknown effects, consumed allowances, and recovery suspension.
6. Current source/root/selection/direction/accepted-state changes remain material. Preserve exact current-state and stale-request refusal and the original historical checks. Do not label an old observation current merely because the authored work is long-lived. Unchanged elapsed time should not force the person to re-enter or reconfirm technical lifetime fields.
7. Use existing ordinary human UI and authenticated agent-facing entrypoints over the same business owner for the affected operations. Keep project, role, delegation, revision, and idempotency boundaries. Do not create a second authority engine, raw-database agent path, dashboard, or recurring approval ritual. An agent already authorized for the operation may act within that scope; this change does not invent a new delegation.
8. Preserve #1392's source-bound handoff interpretation and required historical context wherever the affected local paths touch it. Imported observations retain their attribution and unknown currentness; no source credentials, grants, native-execution qualification, accepted state, or whole-project transfer support is inherited. Do not widen its supported export/import profiles.

**Deciding evidence**

Use disposable projects/databases/roots and the real affected product readers and authenticated writers. Script only external model transport if execution admission needs exercising; provider egress is zero.

- Reproduce the actual pre-change expiry failure in at least one ordinary affected path; distinguish it from the already-durable initial path.
- Exercise new work and a compatible historical finite-work case across the relevant expiry boundary and a multi-day clock advance, including fresh-process readback. Show normal UI/API continuation or editing without internal IDs, TTL entry, DB repair, or a repeated content-review ceremony merely for elapsed time.
- Check equivalent supported human/agent behavior, exact replay/stale concurrency, and material source/direction/selection drift. Where a surface does not yet support an operation, state that precisely rather than claiming parity.
- Demonstrate unchanged historical fingerprints and provenance after reading and resumption. Include reconstruction/backup/restore/portable checks only where impacted; preserve their existing refusal boundaries.
- Demonstrate expired/revoked execution authority still refuses before any external call, and that work resumption itself creates no grant/run or automation permission. If a positive execution-admission check is needed, use a fresh separate disposable grant through the real authorizer with zero-egress scripted transport.
- Run focused checks for changed behavior. Ask the current Local Canonical planner for deciding verification on the final exact clean head, with a freshly resolved base and exclusive ownership; follow its selected plan and cleanup policy. #1392's reported 16/16 pass belongs to its old head and is not this PR's evidence. Preserve failed attempts and do not rerun an unchanged failed deciding target to obtain a pass.
- Report observed behavior, exact source/commands/results, compatibility and authority effects, skipped/unsupported cases, cleanup, and remaining risks. Correctness evidence is not a comparative usefulness or real-candidate result.

**Boundaries and subsequent work**

The retained real continuity candidate, its DB/root, immutable history, accounting, disabled automation, and credentials are outside this implementation's runtime targets. Do not open a new session against that candidate, refresh it, or perform its proposed migration/receive operation. Disposable bounded local tests, including their own authenticated sessions and owned foreground runtimes, are authorized. No live provider request, paid study, service installation, deployment, merge, Ready transition, or auto-merge is commissioned. The earlier proposed real-candidate transfer remains unexecuted and outside scope.

Keep this first PR focused. The audit's cumulative bounds are a following slice: distinguish per-chain revision bounds, capped historical scans, active-slot constraints, and temporary onboarding limits before changing them. Do not treat a temporary selection cap as a total saved-project limit, increase every constant, discard history, or disable a refusal. Include a minimal adjacent correction only if the approved resumption path directly requires it and explain why.

Human/agent project management and hosted Web Planning remain in the overall lifecycle sequence. Define consistent user-visible meaning now; implement their distinct stores/routes in subsequent reviewed slices. Local changes do not automatically update the hosted app, create local/cloud synchronization, or add native authority to Web Planning. Web Planning already has bounded whole-work erasure; native recent-project removal preserves project data. A future discard/cleanup contract must respect that difference and the user's intended deletion scope.

Return one bounded Draft PR linked to this issue, stacked on #1392, with the evidence and active-owner documentation needed for review. Keep existing historical observations intact. If current inspection disproves a supposed defect or shows a requirement already satisfied, report that finding and reduce the change accordingly rather than manufacturing implementation. Leave the issue open for review.

**Review checkpoint — 2026-10-05 (Korea time)**

The bounded local implementation in Draft PR #1394 is accepted at the source-review level for head `02a694f17aa340b1f42df29ec81a76cb3dcd128f`. The review covered the original lifecycle diff and the subsequent cancellation-contract and native-host assertion corrections; no additional concrete defect was identified within that review.

The executing Codex lane reports all 16 final Local Canonical phases passed and receipt validation `valid_deciding_evidence=true`, `issues=[]`, resolving the earlier verification HOLD. ChatGPT checked the current GitHub source and detailed PR report, but did not access or independently validate the Mac's raw receipt/log artifacts. Before-headers cancellation has deterministic private-correlation/actual-callback coverage; the final Browser run did not reproduce that timing. Preserve all three historical failed attempts and the bounded evidence claims.

Keep #1394 Draft and this issue open pending the repository's review/merge workflow. No merge, deployment, installed-service, hosted-parity, or real-candidate acceptance follows from this checkpoint. The next cumulative-history contract is #1395; its implementation has not started in this planning session.
